Rank 01 - Service

Salon Serial and Booking System

People hate arriving at a salon and not knowing how many serials are ahead. Owners lose customers when waiting feels uncertain. A QR/public serial page solves a real-life irritation.

Calculate revenue Open overview

Suggested package

BDT 7,000Installation/setup fee
BDT 350Recommended monthly charge

BDT 350/month is practical because the product is customer-facing and saves owner time every day. Keep BDT 250 as the lowest annual-prepaid tier; do not go below that if support is included.

9.4Practical score based on daily pain, willingness to pay, support load, and expansion potential.
BDT 7,000Default setup used in calculator.
BDT 350Suggested monthly price after support-cost thinking.
BDT 11,200,000Gross year-one revenue at 1,000 businesses.

Why this can work

Start with 1,000 salons in Dhaka, Chattogram, Sylhet, district towns, and busy bazar clusters. This is roughly 10 percent of the mapped-salon signal, before counting informal shops.

Customer asks: how long is the queue? Owner answers manually all day. Staff forgets order. Regular customers call repeatedly. Walk-ins leave when the wait is unclear.

Your customers can scan QR and see current serial before coming. You stop answering the same question all day.

Validation signals

  • Public maps show at least 9,570 salons, likely undercounting informal shops.
  • Every neighborhood has repeat haircut demand.
  • Queue pain is visible to both customers and owners.
  • The app can spread through QR posters and customer sharing.

MVP modules

  • Public salon page with live serial count
  • QR code poster for the door and mirror
  • Owner/staff app to add, call, skip, complete, or cancel serials
  • Optional booking slots for premium salons
  • Staff-wise service list and commission tracking
  • Daily cash close and service count
  • WhatsApp/SMS-ready customer message text

Do not build first

  • Do not build a beauty ecommerce marketplace.
  • Do not build heavy CRM first.
  • Do not force online payment in MVP.

Money model

Change the inputs and see the business case instantly.

Use support cost as a reality check. Low monthly pricing looks attractive until support eats the margin.

First 30-day launch plan

  • Print 50 QR demo posters and visit salon clusters.
  • Offer first 20 salons BDT 5,000 setup if they pay 6 months upfront.
  • Record queue before/after: calls reduced, walk-outs reduced, daily customers counted.
  • Add staff commission only after the queue flow is stable.

Risks and fixes

Risks
  • Owners may say they can manage with a notebook.
  • Staff may forget to update serials during rush.
  • Customers without data may still call.
Mitigations
  • Make staff actions one tap.
  • Show big wall-display mode on any old phone.
  • Let staff share current serial by WhatsApp with one tap.
